sources_used.source: FindOpen USA (Cylex data) - East Brunswick category listings, ~60 group-A categories
Google Maps (browser, visitor view) - attorney / accountant searches
Bing Maps (browser) - accountant and insurance searches
East Brunswick Regional Chamber of Commerce
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory

categories_thin: Architecture and land surveying - only a handful of genuinely local firms (Office Space Planners, Tectonic, CME); most architecture work in the area appears to be done by firms based in Edison/New Brunswick.
Appraisal and notary/process-serving - no dedicated East Brunswick category pages exist in the source directory, so this category is effectively empty here.

Independent (non-franchise) real estate brokerages - the large majority of listings are individual agents at Coldwell Banker/Weichert/RE-MAX/Century 21 offices, which are excluded as franchise locations.
caveats: Most entries come from one bulk directory (FindOpen, republishing Cylex data) that I read page-by-page with a browser; names, phones and suite numbers should be re-confirmed by the triage team.

Excluded as chains/franchises/government found in the source data: Cordell & Cordell, Coldwell Banker / Weichert / RE-MAX / Century 21 / Keller Williams offices and agents, CBRE, Newmark, Chicago Title, Pulte Homes, H&R Block, Jackson Hewitt, Liberty Tax, TurboTax kiosk, State Farm / Allstate / Farmers / Progressive / Nationwide branded agents, AAA, CMIT Solutions, Minuteman Press, FASTSIGNS, Money Mailer, Motto Mortgage, Guaranteed Rate/OriginPoint, Aerotek, Aston Carter, Wipro, Tavant, Merrill Lynch, J.P. Morgan, TD Wealth, Wells Fargo Advisors, Prudential Securities, Santander/Citizens/Bank of America/Northfield/PNC, USPS, fire departments, East Brunswick Public Works.

A few sizable but locally headquartered firms (Withum, Wilkin & Guttenplan, Equiliem, Alpha Consulting, Tectonic, Paychex-type outsourcers) are included with a size note rather than excluded, because the 500-person test is about staff at that site.
Many solo practitioners share office suites at 197 Route 18 'Suite 3000', Auer Court, Brier Hill Court and Tices Lane; they are separate businesses, not separate buildings.
Where two directory entries clearly referred to one firm (same phone/address/website) I merged them and said so in notes.
data_gaps: Yellowpages.com, BBB.org, Cylex direct, Manta, MapQuest, WhereOrg, Opendi and OpenStreetMap Overpass all returned 403/502 from this environment, so those directories could not be read directly.
Google Maps in this browser shows only a 'limited view' (5 results per search, no paging) and Bing Maps shows about 9 per search with no pagination, so map coverage is a supplement, not a spine.
East Brunswick township's own Resource Directory (eastbrunswick.org/BusinessDirectoryII.aspx) lists municipal/regional resources, not local businesses.
The East Brunswick Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory (ebrcc.org) renders through a JavaScript widget and returned no readable member list.
NJ state professional licence look-ups (accountants, engineers, real estate) were not queried because they require interactive form sessions.
Phone numbers are missing for a handful of entries where the directory listing showed none; websites are blank wherever I did not see one linked.
